p:
Guomeng Motor Group was founded in 2014. It is a high-tech enterprise that handles micro motor R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales in one place. Its products are used widely in robotics, personal care, health devices, environmental appliances, kitchen appliances, new energy vehicles, power tools, and other industries.
The Dongguan production base covers about 18,000 square meters, and the Hunan production base covers about 88,000 square meters. We have a first-class R&D and manufacturing management team, with more than 100 R&D staff. The company has already formed partnerships with many leading companies in the industry, including Ecovacs, TINECO, Samsung, Roborock, Xiaomi, Midea, Supor, Joyoung, Dreame, and Befree. We operate by the principle of "honest business, careful work," and we will continue to carry out our corporate mission of "empowering Chinese manufacturing and driving dreams forward."

器、厨电、新能源汽车、电动工具等行业。
东莞生产基地占地约18000平方米，湖南生产基地占地约88000平方米，我们拥有一流的研发和制造管理团队，研发人员超过100人，目前，公司已与科沃斯、添可、三星、石头科技、小米、美的、苏泊尔、九阳、追觅、倍轻松等一大批行业龙头企业达成合作伙伴关系。我们秉持“诚信经营，用心做事”的
经营理念，将持续践行“赋能中国智造，驱动梦想前行”的企业使命
